title: Cascader
description: Selects a value from a hierarchy of options, one level at a time (e.g. country / region / city).

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Click an option to open the next level; choosing a leaf completes the selection.

default-value.title: Default value
default-value.description: defaultValue takes the path of values, one per level.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Pass value and update it in onChange. Clearing calls onChange with an empty array.

hover.title: Expand on hover
hover.description: With expandTrigger="hover", sub-menus open when the pointer hovers a parent option.

search.title: Search
search.description: showSearch lets users type to filter every path; filter customizes the matching.

display-render.title: Custom display
display-render.description: displayRender formats the text shown in the input; here only the last level is displayed and allowClear is off.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Disable individual options with option.disabled, or the whole component with disabled.

lazy-load.title: Load options lazily
lazy-load.description: loadData is called for options without children that are not isLeaf. Set loading on the option and add its children to options when they arrive.

custom-option.title: Custom options and levels
custom-option.description: optionRender renders each option with its level, maxLevel limits the depth, and dropdownStyle / optionStyle adjust the menu.

CascaderProps.label: Label of the input
CascaderProps.name: Name of the input
CascaderProps.onChange: Called when a leaf option is selected or the value is cleared
CascaderProps.displayRender: Formats the text shown in the input; by default labels are joined with " / "
CascaderProps.allowClear: Shows a clear button when a value is selected
CascaderProps.showSearch: Allows typing to search all paths
CascaderProps.filter: Custom search predicate; by default paths whose labels contain the input match
CascaderProps.loadData: Loads children lazily for options without children that are not isLeaf; update options yourself
CascaderProps.dropdownClassName: Additional class name of the dropdown

CascaderOption.value: Value of the option, unique among its siblings
CascaderOption.label: Text displayed for the option
CascaderOption.disabled: Prevents the option from being selected
CascaderOption.isLeaf: Marks the option as a leaf (no children to load) when using loadData
CascaderOption.loading: Shows a loading indicator while its children are being loaded
